company.title: My company
company.description: Name, address, logo and account settings.
company.accountingDescription: Leave these settings as they are if you are not an accountant.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Shown in the menu and on printed invoices.

numbering.description: How invoices, quotes and other papers are numbered.

dialog.warehouseHint: The items sold leave this warehouse.
dialog.cashAccountHint: The cash received is added here.

users.title: Users
users.description: The people who use the application, and what they are allowed to do.
users.emptyDescription: Add an account for each seller, storekeeper or accountant.

dialog.description: Choose what this person is allowed to do.
dialog.keepPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the old one.
dialog.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
dialog.allowOffline: Can sign in without internet on a computer already used with internet

confirmBlock.title: Block the account of {{name}}?
confirmBlock.description: This person will no longer be able to sign in. You can unblock them later.

roles.title: Roles and rights
roles.description: Each role says what a person is allowed to do.

modules.title: Parts of the application
modules.description: Turn on only what you need: the menu stays simple. Hiding a part deletes nothing.

modules.step2Title: Step 2: or choose part by part
